0022600001.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Celtics traveling to face the Pistons in Detroit. Nine Boston players are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions: Derrick White, Devin Carter, Jayson Tatum, Mike Conley, Mitchell Robinson, Neemias Queta, Paul George, Payton Pritchard and Sam Hauser, with all but Carter listed for rest and Carter for illness. The Celtics lost their 2025-26 season series to Detroit 1-3, including a 104-103 loss in Detroit on January 19, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Boston a 50% chance to win.
